steps.title: Harvest iPSCs for DNA extraction
steps.instruction: Grow iPSCs in two wells of a 6‑well plate to ~80 % confluency, aspirate media, wash once with 1 mL DPBS, add 1 mL ReLeSR per well and incubate 45 s in the hood, aspirate ReLeSR, incubate 37 °C 3 min, resuspend cells in 1 mL DPBS, transfer to a 15 mL conical tube, centrifuge 300 × g 3 min, discard supernatant, and either proceed immediately or store cell pellets at –20 °C.

steps.title: Extract genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Using QIAGEN Genomic-tip 100/G protocol with modifications: add 95 µL Proteinase K to the pellet, incubate 55 °C 90 min; precipitate with 3.5 mL isopropanol, invert 4×, centrifuge 4,000 × g 20 min at 4 °C; perform ethanol wash, centrifuge again 4,000 × g 20 min at 4 °C; air‑dry pellet 10 min, resuspend in 50 µL Buffer EB, dissolve overnight at room temperature on a shaker (300 rpm); aliquot 3 µL for QC and store remainder at –20 °C.

steps.title: Assess DNA quality
steps.instruction: Dilute genomic DNA 1:10, measure concentration with Qubit 1× dsDNA HS Assay kit per manufacturer’s protocol; optionally evaluate fragment size (≥50 kb preferred, ≥10 kb acceptable) using Agilent FEMTO Pulse, Bio‑Rad CHEF Mapper XA, or Sage Pippin Pulse; run a 1 % agarose gel as a quick check and include only high‑molecular‑weight DNA.

steps.title: Prepare barcoded adapters
steps.instruction: Resuspend each barcoded adapter oligo in nuclease‑free water to 100 µM. In a PCR tube combine 10 µL 100 µM adapter, 10 µL 10× annealing buffer, 5 µL nuclease‑free water, and 35 µL water to make a 20 µM stock (total 60 µL). Run thermal cycler: 95 °C 5 min, ramp down to 25 °C at maximum cooling rate, hold 4 °C. Store stocks at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare carrier DNA
steps.instruction: Dilute 1 kb DNA ladder by adding 5 µL ladder to 45 µL elution buffer (final 50 ng/µL). Store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Dephosphorylate genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Dilute each DNA sample to 5 µg in nuclease‑free water (final volume 68 µL). Prepare master mix (10 % overage) per sample: 8 µL NEBuffer 8, 4 µL rSAP; add 12 µL master mix to each DNA (total 80 µL). Invert 20×, spin briefly, incubate 37 °C 1 h, then 65 °C 10 min, hold 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare sgRNAs
steps.instruction: Resuspend lyophilized sgRNA‑1 (TTGGTATTTAGAAAGGTGGT) and sgRNA‑2 (GGAAGAAAGAATTGCAATTA) in TE buffer to 50 µM, aliquot and store at –80 °C. Dilute each to 5 µM. In a PCR tube combine 4 µL sgRNA‑1 and 4 µL sgRNA‑2 per sample (10 % overage).

steps.title: Assemble gRNA‑Cas9 complex
steps.instruction: Prepare master mix (10 % overage) per sample: 7 µL nuclease‑free water, 2 µL NEBuffer 3.1, 2 µL Cas9 nuclease (S. pyogenes), 8 µL diluted sgRNA mix. Pipette‑mix, spin, transfer to PCR tube, incubate 37 °C 10 min, then keep on ice.

steps.title: Perform Cas9 digestion
steps.instruction: To each 80 µL dephosphorylated DNA add 1 µL recombinant RNase inhibitor and 19 µL gRNA‑Cas9 complex (10 % overage). Invert 20×, spin, incubate 37 °C 1 h, spin, place on ice.

steps.title: Purify Cas9‑digested DNA
steps.instruction: Transfer each reaction to a new LoBind tube, add 400 µL elution buffer (total 500 µL). Mix AMPure PB beads to homogeneity, add 0.45× volume (≈325 µL) of beads, invert 20×, incubate 15 min RT. Prepare 80 % ethanol (see recipe). Place tubes on magnetic rack until clear (~5 min). Remove supernatant, keep for possible repeat. Wash beads three times with 1 mL 80 % ethanol (add opposite side, wait 30 s, remove). Spin briefly, return to rack, remove residual ethanol with P20. Add 31 µL elution buffer, invert 10× (if beads stick, wait 3 min then invert 10× more). Incubate RT 10 min, spin, place on rack 5 min, collect supernatant to new PCR tube on ice, discard beads. Dilute 1 µL eluate in 4 µL elution buffer, measure concentration with Qubit.

steps.title: Ligate barcoded adapters
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL annealed 20 µM barcoded adapter to each 31 µL DNA (total 32 µL). Prepare ligation master mix (10 % overage) per sample: 5 µL 10× T4 DNA ligase buffer, 12.5 µL nuclease‑free water (total 17.5 µL). Add 17.5 µL master mix to each sample (48.5 µL), invert 20×, add 1.5 µL T4 DNA ligase (total 50 µL), invert 20×, spin, place in thermal cycler: 16 °C 2 h (heated lid off), 65 °C 10 min, hold 4 °C overnight.

steps.title: Pool ligated samples
steps.instruction: Transfer each ligation reaction to a new LoBind tube, centrifuge 14,000 × g 5 min, carefully pipette supernatant (avoid outer‑wall pellet) to a new LoBind tube on ice. If multiplexing, pool equimolar amounts (5–25 µg total DNA per sequencing run). Discard pellet tubes.

steps.title: First SMRTbell library cleanup
steps.instruction: Add elution buffer to pooled sample to 500 µL (if volume ≥500 µL no extra buffer needed). Mix AMPure PB beads, add 0.45× volume (≈225 µL) beads, vortex/flick, spin, vortex 2,000 rpm 10 min to bind DNA, spin, place on magnetic rack until clear (~5 min). Remove supernatant, wash beads three times with 1 mL 80 % ethanol (add opposite side, wait 30 s, remove). Spin, return to rack, remove residual ethanol with P20, repeat until dry. Add 100 µL elution buffer per 5 µg input DNA, mix, incubate RT 5 min, vortex 2,000 rpm 1 min, spin, place on rack 5 min, collect supernatant to new LoBind tube on ice, discard beads. Store SMRTbell library at 4 °C overnight or –20 °C for longer.

steps.title: Nuclease treatment of SMRTbell library
steps.instruction: To the purified library add per 100 µL DNA: 67.2 µL nuclease‑free water, 20 µL 10× CutSmart buffer, 4.8 µL Exonuclease III, 4 µL Enzyme A, 1 µL Enzyme B, 1 µL Enzyme C, 2 µL Enzyme D (10 % overage). Invert 20×, spin, incubate 37 °C 2 h, place on ice. Add 9 µL SOLu‑Trypsin per 200 µL digested library, invert 20×, spin, incubate 37 °C 20 min, place on ice.

steps.title: First nuclease‑treated library cleanup
steps.instruction: Transfer library to new LoBind tube, add elution buffer to 500 µL (if ≥500 µL no extra). Mix AMPure PB beads, add 0.45× beads, vortex/flick, spin, vortex 2,000 rpm 10 min, spin, place on magnetic rack until clear (~5 min). Remove supernatant, keep if needed. Wash beads three times with 1 mL 80 % ethanol as before, spin, remove residual ethanol, add 200 µL elution buffer, mix, incubate RT 5 min, vortex 2,000 rpm 1 min, spin, place on rack 5 min, collect supernatant to new LoBind tube on ice, discard beads.

steps.title: Second nuclease‑treated library cleanup
steps.instruction: Mix AMPure PB beads, add 0.42× beads (≈284 µL) to the first‑purified sample, vortex/flick, spin, vortex 2,000 rpm 10 min, spin, place on magnetic rack until clear (~5 min). Remove supernatant, wash beads three times with 1 mL 80 % ethanol as before, spin, remove residual ethanol, add 6.3 µL elution buffer, mix, incubate RT 5 min, vortex 2,000 rpm 1 min, spin, place on rack 5 min, collect supernatant to new LoBind tube on ice. Store library at 4 °C overnight or –20 °C for longer; ship on dry ice if sending to core.

steps.title: Anneal sequencing primer
steps.instruction: Mix 1 µL sequencing primer v4 stock with 29 µL elution buffer. Add 36 µL 10× primer buffer v2 and 18 µL diluted primer to a PCR tube, flick, spin, run thermal cycler: 80 °C 2 min, hold 4 °C. Transfer to new LoBind tube, keep on ice (store remaining primer at –20 °C ≤30 days).

steps.title: Prime SMRTbell library
steps.instruction: Combine 2.7 µL conditioned sequencing primer v4 with 6.3 µL SMRTbell library (total 9 µL), flick, spin, run thermal cycler: 20 °C 1 h, hold 4 °C.

steps.title: Polymerase binding (Sequel)
steps.instruction: For Sequel: dilute 1 µL Sequel DNA Polymerase 3.0 in 29 µL Sequel Binding Buffer, keep on ice. To primer‑annealed library add 1.5 µL Sequel Binding Buffer, 1.5 µL DTT, 1.5 µL Sequel dNTP, mix, then add 1.5 µL diluted polymerase (total 15 µL). Mix, spin, run thermal cycler: 30 °C 4 h, hold 4 °C (or on ice) until purification.

steps.title: Polymerase binding (Sequel II/IIe)
steps.instruction: For Sequel II/IIe: dilute 1 µL Sequel II DNA Polymerase 2.0 in 29 µL Sequel Binding Buffer, keep on ice. To primer‑annealed library add 1.5 µL Sequel Binding Buffer, 1.5 µL DTT, 1.5 µL Sequel dNTP, mix, then add 1.5 µL diluted polymerase (total 15 µL). Mix, spin, run thermal cycler: 30 °C 4 h, hold 4 °C (or on ice) until purification.

steps.title: Purify SMRTbell‑polymerase complex (Sequel)
steps.instruction: Add 35 µL Sequel Complex Dilution Buffer to a new LoBind tube, add 15 µL sample complex (total 50 µL). Mix AMPure PB beads, add 0.6× beads (≈30 µL), flick, incubate RT 5 min, place on magnetic rack until clear (~2 min). Remove supernatant, spin, return to rack, discard remaining supernatant. Resuspend beads in 81 µL Sequel Complex Dilution Buffer, incubate RT 15 min, place on rack, collect supernatant to new LoBind tube on ice. Dilute Sequel DNA Internal Control Complex 10,000‑fold by two 100‑fold serial dilutions in the same buffer, add 3 µL diluted internal control and 1 µL carrier DNA to the eluate (final volume 85 µL). Transfer to a sample plate, cover, store at 4 °C or on ice until sequencing.

steps.title: Purify SMRTbell‑polymerase complex (Sequel II/IIe)
steps.instruction: Add 35 µL Sequel Complex Dilution Buffer to a new LoBind tube, add 15 µL sample complex (total 50 µL). Mix AMPure PB beads, add 0.6× beads (≈30 µL), flick, incubate RT 5 min, place on magnetic rack until clear (~2 min). Remove supernatant, spin, return to rack, discard remaining supernatant. Resuspend beads in 109.6 µL Sequel Complex Dilution Buffer, incubate RT 15 min, place on rack, collect supernatant to new LoBind tube on ice. Dilute Sequel II DNA Internal Control Complex 10,000‑fold by two 100‑fold serial dilutions in the same buffer, add 4 µL diluted internal control and 1.4 µL carrier DNA (final volume 115 µL). Transfer to a sample plate, cover, keep at 4 °C or on ice until sequencing.

steps.title: Run sequencing
steps.instruction: Load the prepared sample plate onto the appropriate PacBio instrument. Use SMRT Link Run Design with Advanced Options: Immobilization Time = 4 h, No pre‑extension, Movie collection time = 20 h. Generate HiFi reads in SMRT Link (Sequel: “IN SMRT LINK”, Sequel II/IIe: “ON INSTRUMENT”).
